name: Roofing Inbound Calls

hero.headline: Roofing Inbound Calls
hero.subheadline: Connect with high-intent consumers actively looking for roofing solutions.

overview: Roofing Inbound Calls are consumers who see an offer and dial in themselves, generated by Altarious Global performance campaigns and delivered to your business in real time. Real-time roofing web leads delivered to your CRM the moment a homeowner requests repair or replacement, with inbound call and live transfer options.

Homeowners with an active leak or storm damage often want to talk to a contractor immediately rather than wait for a callback. Inbound calls complement the web-lead flow by capturing homeowners who choose to dial in from the same campaigns, reaching the contractor ready to describe the damage and schedule an inspection. Buyers running roofing web leads can add inbound calls to serve urgent, high-intent situations by phone without changing their core lead delivery setup.

This product is suited to web leads businesses with a team ready to answer during defined hours, a clear view of the consumer they want, and the capacity to convert a live conversation. The acquisition objective is simple: put your team in front of roofing consumers at the moment they are deciding.
targetConsumer: Homeowners aged 30 and older who own a single-family home and need roof repair or replacement. The strongest segments are owners of older roofs nearing replacement age, homeowners in regions recently hit by storms or hail, and those pursuing an insurance claim for roof damage who submit an online request for an inspection or estimate.
consumerIntent: Typical intent signals include: submitted an online roof repair or replacement request; roof damaged by a recent storm or hail event; roof is aging or nearing the end of its service life; experiencing leaks or missing shingles.
howGenerated: Calls are generated through call-only and click-to-call performance campaigns targeting searches such as "roof replacement quote" and "roof repair near me", alongside social and comparison placements. Every source is tracked, so call quality can be traced back to the campaign that produced it.
qualification: Qualification is configured to your appetite. Standard roofing criteria include: owns the home where the work will be performed; located in the contractor's service area; has a defined roofing need such as repair or replacement; planning to move forward, with insurance or budget in place; age 18 or older and a decision maker for the household; provided tcpa consent for follow-up contact.
delivery: Calls are routed to your sales line in real time by state or ZIP, schedule and agent availability, with concurrency limits and daily caps set to your capacity. Call tracking and recording are available for quality control.

process.title: PPC / Traffic Acquisition
process.text: Performance campaigns across search, social and comparison placements reach consumers actively looking for roofing solutions.

process.title: Consumer Interest
process.text: The consumer sees a relevant roofing offer with a prominent phone number and a clear reason to call.

process.title: Call Initiated
process.text: The consumer dials directly from the ad or landing page. Nobody is cold-called; the consumer chooses to reach out.

process.title: Qualification
process.text: Optional IVR prompts and duration thresholds screen out wrong numbers, non-prospects and out-of-area callers.

process.title: Inbound Call Delivered
process.text: The call rings your team in real time, routed by geography, schedule and agent availability.

faq.q: How fast are roofing web leads delivered?
faq.a: Leads are delivered in real time through direct CRM or API integration, so a homeowner's request reaches your system within seconds of submission while they are still comparing contractors.

faq.q: Can leads be filtered to storm-affected areas?
faq.a: Yes. Campaigns can be targeted to specific ZIP codes and regions, including areas recently affected by storms or hail, and to homeowners pursuing an insurance claim.

faq.q: Can I combine web leads with calls and transfers?
faq.a: Yes. Web leads are the core product, and inbound calls and live transfers can be added alongside them so you blend real-time leads with live phone connections in one program.
